svg.text: S5-B NEST LANE — S4 with hanging nests of empty boxes
Clean empty boxes stack inside each other in one tall level; the S4 carriage pulls the whole nest and the gallery picks the top box.
S4 aisle shuttle + one nest level, no new motor
nest: up to 13 M, 2.6 kg, 22 mm pitch [unverified]
rear face: nest level, then S and M levels
ONE NEST, seen from the front (at the hand-over)
no lids: they wait at the lid station
S4: one slot each (26 of 99 places)
S5-B: 3 nests share one level (lanes A, B, C)
REAR FACE, bottom: the nest level, lanes A, B, C

g.text: 1/7 The nest level: 13 clean, lid-less empty M boxes stand inside each other in one slot; the lowest one hangs on the runners like any box.
2/7 The S4 carriage goes down to the nest level, measures the nest height and puts its J-hook into the lowest box's hook seat.
3/7 It pulls the whole nest (up to 13 boxes, 2.6 kg) onto the carriage and lifts it to the nest hand-over just under the roof.
4/7 The gallery reaches through the roof hatch, puts its hooks into the gap under the top rim and lifts one empty box out.
5/7 The carriage puts the nest back. For a shopping batch the nest stays up while the gallery takes all the empties it needs.
6/7 Put-away of a washed empty: same presentation; the gallery lowers the box into the nest until its rim sits 22 mm above the last.
7/7 Result: 26 empties take one level instead of 26 slots: 124 boxes held instead of 99, 17 free food places instead of 3.
